versions.content: If Xxx_CompareKey() returns value DCM_E_COMPARE_KEY_FAILED and if the number of failed attempts to enter the requested security level (AttemptCounter) is greater or equal than the value con- figured for the DcmDspSecurityNumAttDelay parameter of the requested security level, the Dcm module shall start the SecurityDelayTimer with the value configured in DcmDspSecurityDelayTime for the SecurityLevel which was requested in the failed request, send a negative response with NRC 0x36 (exceededNumberOfAttempts) and shall not change the Dcm internal security level.
